$comment: Source of the Gully token lists. Addresses here are public on-chain contract addresses (no secrets: this repo is public). name, symbol and decimals are never typed in: tools/build.mjs reads them from the chain. Edit this file in a PR to add a curated token (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

gullyCore.$comment: Gully Core, THE launchpad from 2026-10-29 (gully-ops l3/generated/gully-core.json). Its launches join the extended list with tag gullycore when every leg is locked on chain; logoURI = the on-chain ipfs icon through ipfsGateway. fromBlock = the LaunchpadKitV2 deploy block.

curated.note: WETH9, the canonical wrapped ETH (Gully Swap, the launchpad and Uniswap v3 all use it)
gETH: Hyperlane synthetic of native ETH locked in the HypNative router 0x3Aa7...bad0 on Arbitrum Sepolia
USDC.e: Circle Bridged USDC Standard behind the Arbitrum USDC custom gateways; origin is Circle USDC on Arbitrum Sepolia
glUSD: Gully Pay's stablecoin, minted 1:1 against USDC.e by the PSM
FROG, legacy Gully launchpad launch (test token)
MOSS, legacy Gully launchpad launch (test token)
LABRAT, legacy Gully launchpad launch (test token)

excluded.reason: Arbitrum token-bridge WETH (aeWETH, symbol WETH) minted by the WETH gateway for Arbitrum Sepolia WETH. Total supply 0 and a second 'WETH' confuses pickers; gETH is the supported bridged ETH and WETH9 the wrapped ETH.

extended.$comment: A launchpad token joins the extended list once it has at least minHolders holders and minTxns trades (indexer counts), or has graduated to a Gully Swap pool. Tokens with a published Gully Security report with critical or high findings, and tokens in `excluded`, are left out.
